source_text: The WHO bioassays conducted in Kpome (Benin) in this study indicated that this An. funestus population... was also resistant to DDT, with only 5% mortality 24 hr after 1 hr of exposure to 4% DDT for females
The population from Gounougou in Cameroon was also resistant to DDT, with 52% mortality for females
in line with the low deltamethrin resistance observed in the field in Pahou (88% mortality for deltamethrin vs 66% for permethrin)
